item.title: Burmester 232 Classic Line integrated amplifier
item.description: Burmester 232 Classic Line integrated amplifier John Atkinson Thu, 02/19/2026 - 09:43 Show Promo Image My first response, upon being offered for review the new Burmester 232 Classic Line modular class-AB dual-mono integrated amplifier ($25,000), was apprehension—but not because of the product itself, and certainly not because of the Burmester brand. I had already been won over by the pair of Burmester 218 Top Line stereo power amplifiers ($50,000/each) I reviewed in the October 2024 issue. Jason
